app.title: Cube Type – Isometric Typography Generator
app.author: eustoria
app.description: An online tool that transforms text into isometric 3D cube-style typography, allowing users to generate stylized SVG or PNG images directly in the browser.
proposed_tests: Open the homepage and verify the input text field renders correctly
Submit a sample string via the UI or API (if available) and capture the generated SVG output
Check that the SVG contains <g> and <path> elements with expected class names
Download the PNG export and confirm the file size is greater than zero
Verify the service responds within 2 seconds for a typical 50‑character input
